html:
SMTO-SKL-0050 — The Google Drive task was stopped

GUID: 31aaa5e3-18ac-5d1d-9691-ab086b3e905a
Slug: google-drive-operation-cancelled
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: google-drive

What happened

  • The Drive task stopped part way, because it was stopped or took longer than 15 minutes. Stopping doesn't undo changes Drive already made, and an unfinished download isn't saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you were changing, uploading or moving files, open Google Drive and check which of those changes are already there. Stopping doesn't undo work that Drive had already finished.
  2. Ask SMTO to continue with only the files or steps that aren't done yet. Redoing finished steps could create duplicates.
  3. For a large download or upload, ask for fewer or smaller files at a time so each finishes within 15 minutes. SMTO stops a single Drive task that runs longer than 15 minutes.

What success looks like

  • Everything you wanted appears in Google Drive or in the conversation, with nothing duplicated.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't repeat the whole request from the beginning without checking what already finished.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Drive operation was cancelled: the run's cancel signal was set, the 15-minute Drive operation deadline passed, or artifact registration reported cancellation.

What this means

  • Drive cancellation is set at a checkpoint or artifact registration reports cancellation. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Drive cancellation is set at a checkpoint or artifact registration reports cancellation.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the last provider and artifact receipts for completed or unknown work.

How to fix it

  • DriveClient.check_cancelled raises operation_cancelled when context cancel_event is set or TOTAL_TIMEOUT (15 min) elapses; files.save maps artifact_cancelled to the same code. Review the last receipt and Drive state before resuming; any write whose effect is uncertain must be inspected first, and only the remaining work should be requested.
  • Resume only after reviewing the last receipt; unknown write effects require inspection.

Retry and execution caution

  • Resume only after reviewing the last receipt; unknown write effects require inspection.

How to verify the fix

  • Explicit continuation preserves prior effects and performs only deliberate remaining work.

What not to do

  • Do not expose credentials, content or resumable URLs.
  • Do not blindly repeat uncertain writes.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
